sourceSrs.execution: Each Given/When/Then uses Playwright, fixture setup or outcome assertions directly; independent synthetic owner, analysis and browser context per scenario.
sourceSrs.reports: cucumber-srs.html and cucumber-srs.json are filtered views of the same full run, without rerunning scenarios or changing results.

limitations: CLI identity does not prove SAGE OAuth as this account.
Controlled provider fixtures do not prove live GitHub authorization.
Each SRS scenario uses its own synthetic owner, analysis and browser context; the disposable server/database/worker are shared. Supporting regression suites may reuse a suite run.
Full PDF visual acceptance, process restart recovery and fresh Docker-to-demo acceptance require separate runs.
failureInjection: Pause the owned disposable worker, enqueue via actual UI/POST, corrupt only the owned fixture archive checksum, resume the real worker; restore checksum before real retry.

lifecycleVerification.scope: Actual production Next/worker interruption on disposable PostgreSQL; no OAuth or real user data

independentReview.resolvedFinding: Interrupted Cucumber runs must stop owned Next/worker/Chromium and remove test storage, including a SIGSTOP worker.
independentReview.fix: Idempotent signal cleanup; resume before termination; reap/escalate services; disable competing Chromium SIGINT/SIGTERM exit handlers.
